steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Configure app metadata with app name KKG Store and package name com.kkgstore.store.

steps.title: Setup SQLite Database Helper
steps.description: Implement local database helper schema for customers, products, sales, purchases, expenses, udhaar, and jama ledger entries.

steps.title: Setup 15-Minute Demo Lock Manager
steps.description: Implement DemoLockManager to initialize installation timestamp and calculate demo trial expiration status.

steps.title: Implement Demo Expiry Overlay UI
steps.description: Design layout and activity logic for lock screen when trial expires with direct WhatsApp contact button.

steps.title: Build Store Dashboard Interface
steps.description: Develop main dashboard layout displaying total pending udhaar, received jama, today's sales, and key metric navigation tiles.

steps.title: Build Customer Khata Ledger Management
steps.description: Create screens for listing customer khata accounts, adding new customers, and viewing detailed customer ledger history.

steps.title: Implement Credit and Payment Entry Dialogs
steps.description: Create dialog layouts for recording new credit (udhaar) and payment receipt (jama) transactions.

steps.title: Build Grocery Catalog & Inventory Management
steps.description: Implement product catalog list screen, search functionality, and product addition/editing form with cost and selling rates.

steps.title: Build POS Billing Terminal & Receipt View
steps.description: Develop Point of Sale terminal screen for adding cart items, selecting cash/udhaar payment mode, generating bill, and viewing printable receipt.

steps.title: Build Stock Purchase & Expense Management
steps.description: Implement inward stock purchase registration, stock level increment logic, store expense logging, and expense list views.

steps.title: Build Analytics, Net Margin & Data Backup
steps.description: Implement store financial summary calculations for net margin, revenue breakdowns, daily summary WhatsApp sharing, and data export features.

steps.title: Configure Manifest and App Gradle Build
steps.description: Declare all activity components in AndroidManifest.xml and verify Java 8 build configurations in Gradle.

steps.title: Building KKG Store
steps.description: Compile and assemble the complete APK package for KKG Store.
